title: GDS DB: Fix overflow
description:
The count of the number of supported protocol versions whose description
follows in the connect message is sent on the wire, like all other numbers,
as a 32-bit integer but it should never have the high bytes set.

Also add a URL of the wire protocol documentation, and implement two
fields.
